study: Jev versus Random on the frozen E5 candidate-size cohort
publication_status: Reviewed analysis exports; raw c16/c32 result bundles were not supplied
aggregation: Unweighted workload mean separately within each budget

reported_protocol.candidate_pool_design: Nested prefixes of the same frozen 50-schedule pool
reported_protocol.c50_source: Historical completed 120-by-50 result reused without new sweep calls

metric_definitions.top_5_definition: mean prefix-best runtime ratio over first min(5,n) trials
metric_definitions.pairwise_definition: official strict comparisons in original candidate order
metric_definitions.oracle: minimum runtime among the candidates in each prediction
metric_definitions.ranking_ties: Top-K follows returned order; reported pairwise metrics use model score ties. Tournament selection metrics do not assume global probabilities.

raw_c16_c32_verification_limits: Original predictions, manifests, saved configurations, cache responses and sweep manifest were not uploaded.
Per-workload CSVs can establish reported cohort/aggregate consistency, not independently verify actual candidate identities, nesting, API settings or runtime labels.
A plotted hash of the missing sweep manifest is a recorded reference, not verification of its contents.
Archived c50 results have their separate prior audit; the new c16/c32 exports require a distinct verification status.
interpretation: These are fixed saved responses, not measurements of fresh API repeatability.
Each candidate budget has its own oracle; curve changes are not physical runtime speedups.
The 720 rows represent two models at three budgets over 120 workloads, not 720 independent workloads.
Do not pool budgets into a main overall result or combine them with the separate 484-workload Platinum tournament.
Operation names are recorded composite tensor-program names; small groups are descriptive.

uncertainty.primary: 50000 paired-workload bootstrap resamples, seed 20261116; common workload draws across all budgets
uncertainty.sensitivity: 50000 leading-DAG-hash cluster bootstrap resamples over 56 proxy groups, seed 20261116; not verified independent network families
uncertainty.multiplicity: Exploratory unadjusted intervals for 12 within-budget differences and 8 between-budget contrasts in each analysis
uncertainty.finding: All Top-1/Top-5 and relative-advantage between-budget intervals include zero in both analyses; no significant scaling effect established
uncertainty.conditioning: One saved Jev outcome and one Random seed per workload/budget; missing raw c16/c32 artifacts remain a verification limit
